exposure: Being born large for gestational age (LGA)
Being born small for gestational age (SGA)
outcome: Homeostasis Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance
cohort: The study included 8852 children aged 2-9 years at baseline who participated in up to three examination waves of the pan-European IDEFICS/I.Family cohort.
finding: Being born LGA was positively associated with MetS score and WC z-score, while being born SGA was associated with lower WC and MetS scores but slightly higher SBP and DBP z-scores, and weight gain during pregnancy was associated with higher MetS score and WC z-score.
birth_weight: Large for gestational age (LGA), Small for gestational age (SGA)
gest_age: Large for gestational age (LGA), Small for gestational age (SGA), Premature birth
